notes.title: Hello world...
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!! Vissca here, I have made Alchemixum's steam page public to everyone! So make sure to wish-list it if the concept interests you! Here's some more info on the game:

Alchemixum started as a challenge to myself: can I remake this specific genre of game with my current skills? The answer, yes! In a week I had a very rough prototype of what would lead me to actually invest into wanting this project to exist

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597712/cd73e0bee13461e33a057f00ad1164e7960e1e0d.png[/img]

After messing around with it for a bit I showed it to my friends and let them mess with it and they actually vibed with it, which gave me enough motivation to keep working on it!

My idea for Alchemixum is like: An alchemy game that focuses less on literal alchemy, and more into like actually mixing things, I want a lot of the element combinations to be punny in a way... tho a lot are gonna still make sense, like fire + air = smoke, earth + water = mud but then something like, worm + jungle = snake, because that's what it technically is...

Another important thing I wanted to keep in mind was that I wanted the game to feel alive, to have personality, and that's how Canva, Gaze and Figura were born:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597712/8a49f65ea616f29bb1607adc32d6559699804091.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597712/095a74598dc5c218a3ec800e03ea191e5eae25eb.png[/img]
Little characters to make the game feel less like a tool and give it some more life!

Currently, I'm reworking the game's interface, the store page is going to be outdated visually soon but that's alright, here's the sketches I got and some other progress images:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597712/57edec58433fd19935e2fb6d170647cf1f5661b6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597712/ac0bb32253a69bd6e571e4981596bf3f37e15423.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597712/eabd0522e120a722520cf73e94c8b36a83c6a59d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597712/8addf198c7a9c5411824ab43b29f47798c40b3fa.png[/img]

All I'll be showing for now, and I'll keep y'all updated <3

If you wanna test the game there's a public version over on itch.io, try it out [url=https://visscaguu.itch.io/alchemixum]here[/url].
